zh.title: 用连接软管的喷嘴给植物喷水
zh.question: 人物控制连接软管的喷嘴向植物区域喷水，整体交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察握持喷嘴、手腕导向与手臂和站姿协调，不要求明显后坐。
zh.contact: 软管与喷嘴连接应连续，水束方向和受喷位置应与手部控制相联系。
zh.object: 若叶面湿润、叶片晃动或土面变化，应与水流到达相关，不要求所有植物同步移动。
zh.aftermath: 若水滴下落或喷雾散开，观察来源、重力和延续，不要求固定扇形或水量。
zh.unknown: 仅持管准备，或实际水束及受喷区域不足以评价时选择无法判断。
scores: 人体、软管、喷嘴、水束与植物整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有喷水。
喷水尝试可辨认，但手部导向、出水与植物关键响应严重不符。
持管、出水或叶土变化部分合理，同时有影响喷水的明显异常。
主要喷水、人体协调及软管支撑和水束植物关系合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际喷水可评价，人体、软管、喷嘴、水束及可见植物和滴水后续运动协调，没有明显异常。

zh.title: 在桌面上支撑并整理牛仔裤
zh.question: 人物在木桌上支撑并整理牛仔裤，整体交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察双手对腰部或裤腿的控制、手臂与上身协调，不要求重新完成整条裤子的折叠。
zh.contact: 手与布料接触和按压应与裤子移动相联系，桌面支撑应连续。
zh.object: 牛仔布可起皱、弯折或保持已有折叠，不能仅凭原有整齐状态认定当前操作成功。
zh.aftermath: 若松手或布料滑动，观察层间和桌面的支撑，不要求折痕完全消失。
zh.unknown: 只有展示已折好的裤子，没有足够实际支撑或整理可评价时选择无法判断。
scores: 人体、牛仔裤与桌面关系整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有支撑整理操作。
操作尝试可辨认，但双手作用与布料关键移动或支撑严重不符。
按压、抓持或布料变化部分合理，同时有影响整理的明显异常。
主要整理、人体协调及布层与桌面关系合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际整理可评价，双手、牛仔裤、桌面及可见松手后状态协调，没有明显异常。

en.title: Support and arrange jeans on a table
en.question: How physically plausible is the interaction as the person supports and arranges the jeans on the wooden table?
en.body: Consider hand control of waistband or legs and arm–upper-body coordination. Refolding the whole garment is not required.
en.contact: Hand contact and pressure should relate to garment motion, with continuous table support.
en.object: Denim may wrinkle, fold, or retain existing folds. Existing neatness alone does not establish current success.
en.aftermath: If grip releases or fabric slides, consider layer and table support. Complete crease removal is not required.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if only already-folded jeans are displayed without enough actual support or arranging to assess.
scores: The person, jeans, and table behave implausibly overall, or a clear view confirms no supporting or arranging action.
An attempt is recognizable, but hand action and key fabric motion or support seriously disagree.
Some pressing, grip, or fabric changes are plausible, alongside clear anomalies affecting arranging.
The main arranging, body coordination, and layer–table relation are plausible, with minor local anomalies.
Actual arranging is assessable, and hands, jeans, table, and visible post-release state are coherent without obvious anomalies.

zh.title: 操作平板电脑的折叠保护套
zh.question: 人物按压并操作平板电脑的折叠保护套，整体交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察双手定位、手指按压和手腕协调，不要求明显全身发力。
zh.contact: 手、保护套折线及平板的连接应连续，套片运动应与操作相关。
zh.object: 保护套可沿折线折叠或展开，平板主体应保持可解释的刚性，不要求像布料任意拉伸。
zh.aftermath: 若套片停住或形成支撑，观察桌面接触和平板稳定，不要求唯一支架角度。
zh.unknown: 仅摆放平板或准备按压，实际保护套操作不足以评价时选择无法判断。
scores: 人体、保护套、平板与桌面关系整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有操作保护套。
操作尝试可辨认，但手指作用与套片关键折叠或支撑严重不符。
定位、折线转动或桌面支撑部分合理，同时有影响操作的明显异常。
主要操作、双手协调及套片与平板连接合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际操作可评价，人体、折叠套、平板及可见停止或支撑状态协调，没有明显异常。

en.title: Operate a tablet’s folding protective cover
en.question: How physically plausible is the interaction as the person presses and operates the tablet’s folding cover?
en.body: Consider hand positioning, finger pressing, and wrist coordination. Obvious whole-body effort is not required.
en.contact: Hand, cover crease, and tablet attachment should be continuous, with panel motion related to operation.
en.object: The cover may fold or unfold along creases. The tablet should remain interpretably rigid. Arbitrary fabric-like stretching is not required.
en.aftermath: If panels stop or form support, consider table contact and tablet stability. No unique stand angle is required.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if only tablet positioning or pressing preparation is shown and actual cover operation cannot be assessed.
scores: The person, cover, tablet, and table behave implausibly overall, or a clear view confirms no cover operation.
An attempt is recognizable, but finger action and key panel folding or support seriously disagree.
Some positioning, crease rotation, or table support is plausible, alongside clear anomalies affecting operation.
The main operation, hand coordination, and panel–tablet attachment are plausible, with minor local anomalies.
Actual operation is assessable, and the person, cover, tablet, and visible stopping or support state are coherent without obvious anomalies.
